perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.desc: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Insurmountable looks to be a decent Void sidearm for most activities. The issue is most sidearms don't scare up to GM levels easily. The synergy is there but when it takes 2-3 mags to down a red bar what's the point. In low end activities it can be incredibly strong. Just please don't take it into any real high power level activities." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "However, in the crucible where health is normalized you can do a lot with this pew pew. It bridges the gap between a traditional sidearm and a hand cannon well enough that you can slay out within CQC. Lone Wolf will make those shots feel sticky and Desperate Measures can scale with any subclass ability. Closing Time is interesting but wouldn't be my first pick. If you swap weapons a lot then look for Harmony and Threat Detector for maximum feel and damage." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 119 from 22 October 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6CEZXurwhqejVZpX506M2a?si=7ef44c5f06ae4412) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways, and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor enemies in general, non-underleveled content, particularly with Void builds. Insurmountable is a void precision sidearm, which means you can basically ignore the Recoil Direction stat. At base, 50 Range equates to 15.60m when ADS, 38 Handling is 0.32s ready, 0.26s ADS speed and 0.35s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 21 is a 1.90s reload. Range on sidearms is pretty compressed, so a barrel perk offering Handling is probably your first choice, maybe with a touch of Stability if you're on controller. In the magazine, look for perks that provide extra shots or faster reloads. For void synergy, the trait perk combination of Repulsor Brace and Destabilizing Rounds, keep you safe with an Void Overshield while you're clearing crowds of volatile enemies - maybe to pair with Echoes of Persistence and Starvation. The Dark Ether origin trait is one of the best in the sandbox for PvE - generate a Dark Ether charge for 5s from kills, and then shoot with any weapon (or run into) the charge to proc a Dragonfly-type detonation which also overflows your weapon to ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced, completely bypassing reload. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod, or possibly a Synergy (to proc Echo of Starvation), Tactical or Ammo Finder Enhancement mod when enhanced.
